pages.text: $(bold)Jack will not fold?$(reset) Check the box, driver’s seat, shafts, two small front wheels and two large rear wheels. Install while extended; clicks during animation are ignored.$(br2)$(bold)Part will not fit?$(reset) Check its mounting area, space and box size. Three-seat benches require a wide box.

$(bold)Controls do nothing?$(reset) Assemble an entity, fill all required hitches and take the driver’s position: left on a double bench, middle on a triple.$(br2)$(bold)Cannot board a stool?$(reset) Check occupancy and clearance above it. Cargo, fabric, world blocks or physical structures may block a rider; tall entities need more room.

$(bold)Cargo will not respond?$(reset) Fabric, conversion, server placement rules or an unsupported workstation may be responsible. Try an unobstructed approach.$(br2)$(bold)Mat will not fit?$(reset) It needs three slots in the same column toward the front. Empty slots behind your target do not count. Stop before sleeping.

Server rules live in $(bold)tm_wagon-server.toml$(reset), including cargo lists, speed, load effects and handbook gifts.$(br2)With Patchouli installed and gifts enabled, any player without a recorded gift receives one on login, including in existing worlds. The handbook item and recipe are unavailable without Patchouli.

pages.text: A book, lead and any planks. Shapeless recipe.
